contracts.boundary: Real pinned Pi TUI offers a concise tool-generated summary or a user-selected sequential exact review before one guarded write. Summary explicitly identifies classifier disablement, removed/replaced rules, model-pool changes, and fallback changes; exact review displays the full 6,000-character value and suffix. Summary Apply is explicit; exact-view Apply is gated to its final rendered page. Resize and cancellation fail closed.
contracts.assertions: Unit tests check summary counts and classifier/rule/model-pool/fallback deltas; summary and exact pager traversal, Unicode wrapping, cancellation, resize invalidation, stale source/effective/catalog guards, one write, reload, and TUI-unavailable behavior. Real Pi PTY test traverses and checks classifier, rule removals, model-pool and fallback changes in the summary, selects exact review, confirms early exact Apply writes nothing, verifies the entire repeated value across rendered pages, cancels safely, applies exact after resize reset, and separately applies from the final summary page. Isolated Pi fault copy removes the classifier-impact summary line and must fail the real-Pi display assertion. Current Pi has no ExtensionUIContext file-open API; unsupported behavior is reported instead of fabricating an open action.

boundaryTest.name: requires complete paged approval in real pinned Pi across viewport resize

invariant.name: summarizes classifier, rule, model-pool, and fallback changes from the checked candidate

fault.name: detects a faulty summary that hides classifier disablement in an isolated Pi copy
